verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents dynamic group membership rules or assigning enterprise apps to groups. The nearby items cover different capabilities: SCIM provisioning of users and groups into apps, lifecycle workflows, and direct assignment of external users to access packages. Provisioning group objects downstream and assigning users directly are not rule-based group membership driving app access, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an IT admin, access is assigned by group and rule — dynamic group membership and group-based app assignment replace one-by-one grants
